functions.title: Global functions
functions.intro: Functions that answer on every site. A site's own functions answer first, then these, then the site's files.
functions.live.title: Live functions
functions.errors.title: Nothing was deployed. The live functions are unchanged.
functions.files.label: Live files
functions.files.removeConfirm.one: Remove {file}? The {count} other file is compiled and deployed without it. If it uses {file}, nothing changes and you see the error.
functions.files.removeConfirm.other: Remove {file}? The {count} other files are compiled and deployed without it. If they use {file}, nothing changes and you see the error.
functions.files.removeTitle: Remove {file} and deploy the rest again
functions.status.loadedBackground: Loaded at {time}. Their background services are running.
functions.status.loadedJobs: Loaded at {time}. Their jobs are running.
functions.status.loadedBoth: Loaded at {time}. Their background services and jobs are running.
functions.status.notLoaded: Not loaded yet. The functions load on the first request.
functions.status.notLoadedBackground: Not loaded yet. The functions load on the first request or when the server has started, so their background services can run.
functions.status.notLoadedJobs: Not loaded yet. The functions load on the first request or when the server has started, so their jobs can run.
functions.status.notLoadedBoth: Not loaded yet. The functions load on the first request or when the server has started, so their background services and jobs can run.
functions.status.failed: These functions could not be loaded, so they answer nothing: {message}
functions.status.failedClosedGlobal: They include middleware, so every site answers `503` until you fix them and deploy them again. No request gets past a gate that did not load.
functions.status.failedClosedSite: They include middleware, so the site answers `503` until you fix them and deploy them again. No request gets past a gate that did not load.
functions.status.failedFix: Fix them and deploy them again.
functions.status.failedLog: The details are in the server log.
functions.newer.message: These functions were compiled against `StaticSiteHost.Abstractions` {version}, which is newer than the {serverVersion} this server runs. They are not loaded and answer nothing.
functions.newer.fix: To compile them against this server's copy, deploy them again from the editor, or upload the source again.
functions.newer.closedGlobal: They include middleware, so every site answers `503` until then.
functions.newer.closedSite: They include middleware, so the site answers `503` until then.
functions.middleware.title: Middleware
functions.middleware.hint: Runs in this order on every request, including requests for files, before any route answers.
functions.source.openAt: Open in the editor at line {line}
functions.routes.title: Routes
functions.services.title: Services
functions.services.hint: Run once, in this order, as the functions load. They register what the routes, jobs and background services use.
functions.background.title: Background services
functions.background.hint: Run for as long as the functions are live. One that throws starts again after a pause.
functions.jobs.title: Jobs
functions.jobs.hint: Schedules and times are in UTC. A job skips a run while its last run is still going, and does not make up runs missed while the server was down.
functions.jobs.onStartTitle: Also runs as the functions load
functions.jobs.skippedTitle: Came due while the last run was still going
functions.hooks.title: Hooks
functions.hooks.hintGlobal: The global functions' hooks never decide anything. Only a site's own functions decide who may use its realtime hub or AI.
functions.hooks.hintSite: Decide who may use the site's realtime hub and AI. If a hook throws, or the functions cannot be loaded, the request is refused.
functions.hooks.realtimeConnect: who may connect to the realtime hub, and who they are
functions.hooks.realtimeJoin: which realtime groups a page may join
functions.upload.busy: Compiling… The first build restores packages and can take a minute.
functions.upload.hint: You can upload several files at once, including the `.zip` that **Download source** gives you. Files that use `StaticSiteHost.Abstractions` compile against this server's copy, version {version}.
functions.upload.modeLegend: What to do with the files already live
functions.upload.merge: **Add or update these files.** A file with the same name is replaced, and the other live files stay.
functions.upload.replace: **Replace all files.** The upload becomes the complete set, and live files you leave out are removed.
functions.remove.confirm: Remove the global functions? Every site stops answering their routes. To get them back, upload their source again.
functions.noRollback: Global functions cannot be rolled back: each upload goes live on every site at once. To keep a copy of the live files, download the source first.
functions.upload.noFiles: Choose `.cs` or `.linq` files, or a `.zip` of them, to upload.
functions.remove.done: Removed the global functions. Sites still run their own functions.
functions.error.noFiles: Add at least one `.cs` or `.linq` file.
functions.error.sameName: Two files are named {name}. Each file needs its own name.
functions.error.fileLimit: {name} is over the {limit} limit for one file.
functions.error.totalLimit: Together the files are over the {limit} limit.
functions.error.notText: {name} is not a text file. Upload `.cs` or `.linq` files, or a `.zip` of them.
functions.error.notZip: {name} is not a readable zip archive.
functions.error.zipEntries: {name} holds more than {max} entries, which is more than a set of functions needs.
functions.error.zipFileLimit: {name}: {path} is over the {limit} limit for one file.
functions.error.zipNoFiles: {name} has no `.cs` or `.linq` files at its top level or in a `{folder}` folder.
functions.error.disk: The functions could not be written to disk. Check the server logs.
functions.error.buildTimeout: The build did not finish within {minutes} minutes and was stopped.
functions.error.noSdk: The .NET SDK is not available on the server, so functions cannot be compiled.
functions.error.buildExitCode: The build failed with exit code {code}.
functions.error.noAssembly: The build reported success but produced no assembly.
functions.error.notLiveFile: {name} is not one of the live files.
functions.error.onlyFile: {name} is the only file. Remove the functions altogether instead.
functions.error.noneToRemove: This site has no functions to remove.
functions.test.bodyLimit: The request body is limited to {size} MB.
functions.test.timeout: The function did not finish within {seconds} seconds.
functions.test.noRoute: No route matches {method} {path}. On the live site this request would fall through to the site's files.
functions.test.nothingLive: Nothing is live to test. Check the files, then test the checked build.
functions.test.expired: That checked build has expired. Check the files again.
